aspect: The questioning is the procedure, not a response to anything
description: Who packed the bag, who did you meet, what is your father's name, your grandfather's name, why is your Arabic better than your Hebrew. The answers do not change the outcome; the process is the point.
energy_note: Three hours of questions with no right answer.

description: Bags opened on a table in front of other passengers, belongings handled, sometimes clothing searched. The humiliation is a component rather than a side effect.
energy_note: Your underwear, on a table, in front of the queue.

aspect: For women it includes searches that are hard to describe afterwards
description: Body searches conducted in side rooms are reported consistently and described rarely, because describing them is its own cost.
energy_note: The part of the journey she won't talk about.

aspect: It has to be budgeted for
description: Arriving four to five hours early is not caution, it is arithmetic. That time is unpaid, repeated, and spent by every member of the family every time they fly.
time_note: Cumulative days per year at airports before check-in.
energy_note: A working week a year, standing in a terminal.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the document that only works at one airport
description: The Israeli laissez-passer held by East Jerusalem Palestinians permits travel only via Israeli airports, while the Jordanian temporary passport most of them also hold cannot be used to transit Ben Gurion. Two documents, each valid for the leg the other cannot cover.
energy_note: Two travel documents, one journey, neither sufficient alone.
